body.text: We are located on the 4th floor of the Kamirokutoki Building. Please use the elevator.

facilities.name: reception
facilities.body: We ask that you keep your medical card and fill out the medical questionnaire.

facilities.name: waiting room
facilities.body: A USB port is available at each seat. You can wait comfortably while protecting your privacy with the partition.

facilities.name: counseling room
facilities.body: This is a private room where you can have a calm consultation.

facilities.name: hair removal room
facilities.body: This is a treatment room exclusively for medical hair removal.

facilities.name: peeling room
facilities.body: This is a room where treatments such as peeling are performed.

facilities.name: operating room
facilities.body: Treatments are performed in a clean environment.
